name: WinXp
description: Windows XP desktop recreated in the browser with native HTML, CSS and JavaScript — 56 apps across 11 packages, a virtual filesystem and a WebGPU wallpaper renderer with WebGL2 and Canvas 2D fallbacks.

paragraphs: Live demo: — node scripts/build-pages.mjs writes the static site to site/ with relative URLs so it works under any base path; the Deploy to GitHub Pages workflow publishes it on every push to main.
A Windows XP desktop and application recreation written in native HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It runs as a static website and stores its virtual files in the current browser profile.

The integrated registry contains 56 app definitions across 11 reusable packages, including Explorer, editors, raster graphics, games, media, accessibility tools, and system-style utilities. Some definitions are property dialogs or information tools rather than large standalone applications. The desktop wallpaper uses a real WebGPU renderer with WebGL2 and Canvas 2D fallbacks. Application controls use semantic HTML/CSS; Paint, image processing, game tables, and visualizations use their documented DOM or Canvas paths.

whatItDoes.text: Live demo: — node scripts/build-pages.mjs writes the static site to site/ with relative URLs so it works under any base path; the Deploy to GitHub Pages workflow publishes it on every push to main.

requirements.text: It is not an authentication or security boundary, and it does not create a host operating-system account.
